Diagnose temporal spread of a fixed linear deconvolution operator

Source: R/deconvolution_impulse_diagnostics.R
deconvolution_impulse_diagnostics.Rd

Generate isolated unit impulses at actual event times, convolve them with a known HRF, and measure their recovery and entry into other event windows.

Usage

deconvolution_impulse_diagnostics(
  event_data,
  kernel,
  n_time,
  tr,
  lambda,
  onset = "onset",
  trial = "trial",
  time_offset = 0,
  time_before = -3,
  time_after = 3,
  output_resolution = tr,
  backend = c("cpp", "r", "wiener"),
  penalty = c("diff2", "diff1", "ridge"),
  forward_kernel = NULL,
  prewhiten_rho = 0,
  ridge_floor = 1e-08,
  input_scale = 1,
  input_demean = FALSE,
  tail_padding = 0L,
  source_trials = NULL,
  batch_size = 32L,
  return_timeseries = FALSE
)

Arguments

event_data

Data.frame with unique trial labels and numeric onsets.

kernel

Frozen inverse-model HRF. Normalized to unit sum.

n_time

Number of measured acquisition samples (at least three).

tr

Acquisition interval in seconds.

lambda

Fixed regularization strength; automatic tuning is not performed.

onset, trial

Names of onset and trial columns in event_data.

time_offset

Absolute time assigned to the first acquisition.

time_before, time_after

Requested window limits relative to each event.

output_resolution

Spacing of the diagnostic window grid, in seconds.

backend

Linear backend: cpp, r, or scalar wiener. Adaptive PSD and nonlinear estimators are not supported.

penalty

Fixed quadratic penalty for cpp/r.

forward_kernel

Generating HRF, defaulting to kernel. Use a different shape for a specified HRF-mismatch experiment. Also normalized to unit sum.

prewhiten_rho

Frozen AR(1) coefficient; zero disables whitening.

ridge_floor

Fixed numerical ridge floor for cpp/r.

input_scale

Fixed positive BOLD divisor from the fitted run. Recovery is multiplied back by this divisor to report activity in injected-impulse units.

input_demean

Whether to subtract each simulated measured BOLD mean before padding. This applies a fixed linear centering operation, not z-scoring.

tail_padding

Number of zero BOLD samples appended as observations. Use length(kernel) to reproduce the current voxelwise wrapper's padding.

source_trials

Optional trial labels to inject; all are used by default. All event_data rows remain target windows. Subset sources for large schedules.

batch_size

Maximum number of impulse columns fitted together.

return_timeseries

Include full acquisition-grid truth, BOLD, and recovered activity for each selected source (default FALSE).

Value

A list with impulses (one status/summary per selected source), windows (directed source/target metrics), optional time_series, and frozen settings.

Details

Off-grid events deposit mass on the two surrounding acquisition bins; this is a grid approximation, not a sub-TR neural-resolution claim. The injected samples sum to one (area tr). Missing/outside onsets and impulses producing no observed BOLD variation retain explicit statuses and missing recovery metrics. Windows use overlapping support without collision censoring. window_l1_ratio compares absolute recovered area in a target window with that in the source's own window. Windows may overlap, so ratios are not fractions of neural attribution and may exceed one. Metrics condition on fixed model settings and the specified generating HRF. No noise, retuning, observation- mask refitting, or physiological uncertainty estimation is performed.
